subject: ENGLISH
title: Whose Is It? · M01 D16
objective: Use possessive pronouns to show ownership.
introduction: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, and theirs can stand alone and replace a possessive noun phrase. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: Showing who owns something, like Milo's.
A word that names a person, place, or thing.
A group of words that tells a complete idea.
